title: Elon Musk visits the country often, developing islands he owns -- PH envoy
summary: Businessman Elon Musk was in the Philippines, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez confirmed Thursday, amid rumors spreading online.

blocks.text: Businessman Elon Musk was in the Philippines, Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez confirmed Thursday, amid rumors spreading online.

Romualdez said Musk landed in the country on Wednesday, November 18. He is now with US President Donald Trump, who is in China for the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting.

“Yes, he was [here]... He did land on his private plane at 11:30, I think in the morning yesterday, and he just went directly to Air Force One and waited there for President Trump. He is now with President Trump in China,” Romualdez said in an interview.
According to information shared with him, Romualdez said Musk often visits the Philippines and is currently developing one or two islands he owns.
“Elon Musk comes here often because he has one or two islands that, I’m told, he’s developing,” the envoy said.

“Again, that’s a big sign. The richest man in the world is actually very interested in the Philippines, he loves the Philippines. I had one conversation with him and I think that you could see he has quite a lot of knowledge about the Philippines,” he added. — Lyjah Tiffany Bonzo/BAP, GMA News
